race.comment: ROCKBOURG (4) is the one to beat after placing on debut at Albury, finishing just under three lengths behind Complaisance. Off a long break but has trialled well and strikes a very winnable race fresh. SEALAND (5) has more race fitness, with a strong Sale second two runs ago and a Ballarat ninth that's easier to excuse due to racing wide. Can bounce back. ROYAL TEA (11), a debut filly with a Cranbourne trial win, merits respect given her stable's strong debut record of seven placings from 14 starters and she draws well for Neindorf. Watch betting. SHALWEDASH (6) has consistently trialled well for the Zahra yard, including a close third at Flemington. Drawn low and looks a solid chance. EXCLUSIVE PUNT (9) perhaps next best.
